James H. Muncey
Preserved Primary Document • munce-j1.htm
James H. Munce was born in Kent Co., DE on 27 August,
1837
. He was the son of  Robert Munce, Jr.  and Jemima Hansor.
On 14 October,
1862
he married Hester Annie Cork who was the daughter of Peregrine Cork and
Hannah Concilor. Hester was
born in Kent County DE on January 4,
1837
. She died on August 23,
1904
Photo of Hester Annie Cork c.
1870
courtesy of Harry Muncey
James adapted the spelling of the family's name to MUNCEY and his descendants continue that spelling today. It is possible that Muncey was the original spelling of the name.
James and Hester had the following children:
Ida Effie Muncey (3 Jan.
1864
- 2 Oct.
1947

1865

1869
-
16 May 1947
) married Carrie Boyton

1875
-
23 July 1961
)

1877

James H. Muncey

Preserved Primary Document • munce-j1.htm

James H. Munce was born in Kent Co., DE on 27 August, 1837. He was the son of Robert Munce, Jr. and Jemima Hansor. On 14 October, 1862 he married Hester Annie Cork who was the daughter of Peregrine Cork and Hannah Concilor. Hester was born in Kent County DE on January 4, 1837. She died on August 23, 1904 Photo of Hester Annie Cork c. 1870 courtesy of Harry Muncey James adapted the spelling of the family's name to MUNCEY and his descendants continue that spelling today. It is possible that Muncey was the original spelling of the name. James and Hester had the following children: Ida Effie Muncey (3 Jan. 1864- 2 Oct. 1947) Perry Muncey (15 Aug. 1865-7 May 1869) James Pennell Muncey (20 Jan. 1869-16 May 1947) married Carrie Boyton Bessie Mae Muncey (27 Sept. 1875 - 23 July 1961) Earl Warren Muncey (20 Sept. 1877- 22 April 1957) Photo of Angelica Munce Miller, James H. Muncey & Hester Cork Muncey Photo courtesy of Harry Muncey

It is possible that Muncey was the original spelling of the name.
